post.description: This endpoint allows refreshing the access token using the `refreshToken`  and also updates the session using the `sessionId` stored in the `httpOnly` cookies. The server retrieves both the `refreshToken` and `sessionId` from the cookies,  validates them, and responds with a new access token and updated session.

get.description: Retrieves a complete list of contacts from the database, including  `name`, `email`, `phone number`, `contactType`, `userId` and other(look in example).  This endpoint supports optional query parameters for `filtering`, `sorting`, and `pagination`.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: You can sort contacts by name. If the 'sortBy' field exists in the query parameters, contacts will be sorted by '_id' by default.

post.description: This operation allows the creation of a new contact in the system with specified details, including the `name`, `phone number`, `email`, and type of contact `(work, home, personal)`. The user can also mark the contact as a favourite and upload a photo, if desired.  The request requires authentication, and it can handle data in both JSON and multipart form-data formats

name.description: Contact's name. Contact's name. min 3 max 20 characters

isFavourite.description: A boolean field representing whether the contact is marked as a favourite. True if the contact is a favourite, otherwise false.

contactType.description: "This is a field for specifying the type of contact; it is restricted to the following values: work, home, or personal
